actions.label: Set Out on an Expedition
actions.description: Take a day to explore the country around you. The route may reveal a local crisis, a useful contact, or a choice that changes regional standing.

effects.memory: You set out to explore the roads and settlements of the current country.

actions.label: Explore the Village
actions.description: Move through familiar streets, test your confidence, and notice what adults overlook.

effects.memory: You spent the day learning the shape of your village.

actions.label: Help at the Market
actions.description: Carry supplies and help local shopkeepers. Earn a small wage and build a reputation for reliability.

effects.memory: You helped a market shopkeeper and earned a little Ryo.

actions.label: Practice at the Village Forge
actions.description: Learn safe hammer control, basic repairs, and how to read the grain of shinobi-grade metal.

effects.memory: You practiced a careful repair at the village forge and improved your smithing.

actions.label: Quiet Rest
actions.description: Spend an unhurried day at home, letting your body and mind settle.

effects.memory: You had a quiet day at home and felt more rested afterward.

actions.label: Play and Explore
actions.description: Follow a small curiosity, make a game of it, and notice what you can do now.

effects.memory: A game turned into a new discovery about the world around you.

actions.label: Body Conditioning
actions.description: Run drills, repeat forms, and let consistency build a stronger base.

effects.memory: You completed another set of body-conditioning drills.

actions.label: Academy Study
actions.description: Work through village history, shinobi basics, and the theory behind hand signs.

effects.memory: You studied academy material until the light faded.

actions.label: Chakra Control
actions.description: Practice the slow work of sensing, shaping, and retaining chakra without waste.

effects.memory: You focused on keeping your chakra steady for one breath longer.

actions.label: Hand Seal Drills
actions.description: Repeat standard sequences until your hands move before doubt can interrupt them.

effects.memory: You drilled basic hand seal sequences until they felt less foreign.

actions.label: Tree Walking
actions.description: Anchor controlled chakra through the soles of your feet and climb without breaking focus.

effects.memory: You climbed farther before your chakra slipped from the bark.

actions.label: Water Walking
actions.description: Balance output against movement on an unstable surface without forcing your chakra.

effects.memory: You held the surface of the water for a few steady steps.

actions.label: Sparring Drills
actions.description: Use controlled matches to find the gap between what you know and what you can execute.

effects.memory: A sparring partner exposed a flaw you can now work on.

actions.label: Endurance Run
actions.description: Build stamina on a long route through the village outskirts and return at your own pace.

effects.memory: You finished an exhausting endurance run around the village.

actions.label: Breath and Focus
actions.description: Slow your breathing and learn to notice when your chakra begins to wander.

effects.memory: You practiced quiet focus and held your attention through distraction.

actions.label: Target Practice
actions.description: Practice throwing forms, adjust your stance, and learn how small corrections change a shot.

effects.memory: You spent the afternoon improving your aim at the practice range.

actions.label: Chakra Reserve Drill
actions.description: Cycle small amounts of chakra carefully, building reserve without sacrificing control.

effects.memory: You practiced circulating chakra in measured cycles to deepen your reserve.

actions.label: Study a Shinobi Topic
actions.description: Choose a subject that interests you and follow the questions wherever they lead.

effects.memory: You followed your curiosity into a shinobi subject of your own choosing.

actions.label: Wind Nature Practice
actions.description: Learn to make your chakra feel sharp and directional without losing its shape.

effects.memory: You began learning how your wind nature moves through chakra.

actions.label: Fire Nature Practice
actions.description: Practice shaping warmth into steady output instead of letting it flare and scatter.

effects.memory: You learned to keep fire-nature chakra steady through a controlled release.

actions.label: Water Nature Practice
actions.description: Study how to keep chakra responsive and continuous as its shape changes.

effects.memory: You practiced guiding water-nature chakra through several changing forms.

actions.label: Earth Nature Practice
actions.description: Build a stable flow that holds its shape under pressure.

effects.memory: You practiced maintaining a grounded, even flow of earth-nature chakra.

actions.label: Lightning Nature Practice
actions.description: Focus on precision and fine control as you guide a fast, unstable current.

effects.memory: You learned to guide lightning-nature chakra without letting it break your focus.

actions.label: Inuzuka Clan Training
actions.description: Combine movement, senses, and physical coordination in your clan's training style.

effects.memory: You trained in the Inuzuka family's direct, physical style.

actions.label: Yamanaka Clan Focus
actions.description: Practice the concentration and awareness expected of a Yamanaka shinobi.

effects.memory: You practiced the Yamanaka tradition of focused awareness.

actions.label: Uchiha Clan Forms
actions.description: Build the discipline, observation, and hand-seal precision taught in your clan.

effects.memory: You practiced the Uchiha clan's disciplined forms and observation drills.

actions.label: Gentle Fist Forms
actions.description: Practice close-range forms that demand precise movement and chakra control.

effects.memory: You practiced the Hyuga Gentle Fist forms with careful control.

actions.label: Nara Strategy Study
actions.description: Review situations, predict likely choices, and plan how a team should respond.

effects.memory: You studied a Nara strategy exercise and considered several possible outcomes.

actions.label: Take the Genin Qualification
actions.description: Put your academy study, control, and physical preparation to the test.

effects.memory: You passed your village's Genin qualification and began your shinobi career.

actions.label: Enter a Chunin Exam Cycle
actions.description: Commit to an exam cycle that tests judgment, capability, and teamwork.

effects.memory: You advanced to Chunin after demonstrating the experience and judgment your village required.

actions.label: Take the Jonin Assessment
actions.description: Show that your skill, judgment, and record are ready for a leadership rank.

effects.memory: You earned Jonin rank after years of training and service to your village.

actions.label: Learn Transformation Technique
actions.description: Learn the basic hand signs and chakra shaping behind a foundational academy technique.

effects.memory: You learned the Transformation Technique through careful academy practice.

actions.label: Learn Clone Technique
actions.description: Practice the focus needed to form a stable illusionary clone.

effects.memory: You learned the Clone Technique and began refining its chakra shape.

actions.label: Learn Substitution Technique
actions.description: Study timing, preparation, and the chakra control needed to escape an attack.

effects.memory: You learned the Substitution Technique and practiced its timing.
